kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
تبحثرت (form IIq)
# تَبَحْثَرْتُ (tabaḥṯartu) /ta.baħ.θar.tu/: first-person singular past active of تَبَحْثَرَ (tabaḥṯara)
# تَبَحْثَرْتَ (tabaḥṯarta) /ta.baħ.θar.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of تَبَحْثَرَ (tabaḥṯara)
# تَبَحْثَرْتِ (tabaḥṯarti) /ta.baħ.θar.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of تَبَحْثَرَ (tabaḥṯara)
# تَبَحْثَرَتْ (tabaḥṯarat) /ta.baħ.θa.rat/: t
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
